builds.name: Boneshatter Juggernaut
builds.summary: League-start melee build. Boneshatter trades a little life for stacks, so the gear is armour and resistances, the axe is a rare with attack speed, and the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable. No unique is required, which is what a strength build needs on day one of a solo league.

builds.name: Lightning Arrow Deadeye
builds.summary: League-start bow build. One skill in the body armour, a physical bow with attack speed, and gem levels carry the damage: nothing here needs a unique, so the same gear works on day one of a solo league. It is the second build the pipeline proves, and the first that is not a minion one.

builds.name: Summon Skeletons Necromancer
builds.summary: League-start minion build. Skeletons do the damage, so a bad weapon is not a brick: cap your resistances, keep your minions alive, and the damage arrives with the gem levels. No required uniques, which is why it is the first build the pipeline proves.
